reviews.title: Please read!
reviews.text: Scan Guru advertised a free trial but then charged high, undisclosed, and recurring subscription fees. I canceled the application before the 7‑day trial ended—specifically on 03/02/2026—and I have a screenshot confirming the cancellation. Despite canceling on time, I was still charged, and I am now being billed for an additional week even though the subscription period ended on 03/19. These charges were not authorized, and the renewal terms were not clearly disclosed. I am requesting a full review of this issue and a refund for all improper or misleadingly obtained fees.
